# quiz-ui

> Radix-based component library for building quiz funnels. Distributed
> shadcn-style: install individual components as source via the shadcn
> CLI against this registry, not as an npm dependency.

Setup (once): add `"@quiz-ui": "https://quiz-ui.dev/r/{name}.json"` to
the `registries` map in the project's components.json.
Install: npx shadcn@latest add @quiz-ui/<name>
AI-assisted install: npx shadcn@latest mcp init  (reads components.json's
registries map — do the setup step first)
Full registry manifest: https://quiz-ui.dev/r/registry.json

## Core (installs automatically as a dependency of any component)

- @quiz-ui/quiz-core — headless engine: QuizDefinition, QuizProvider, useQuizEngine, useQuizStep, useQuizAnswers.
- @quiz-ui/quiz-cn — className helper (clsx + tailwind-merge).

## Components

- @quiz-ui/quiz-root — top-level funnel wrapper, owns the engine.
- @quiz-ui/quiz-step — renders the active step's question + input.
- @quiz-ui/quiz-progress — progress bar with step count.
- @quiz-ui/quiz-choice — single/multi-select answer cards.
- @quiz-ui/quiz-image-choice — visual/image-based single-select grid.
- @quiz-ui/quiz-slider — numeric range answer.
- @quiz-ui/quiz-rating — star or numeric rating scale.
- @quiz-ui/quiz-text-input — free-text answer.
- @quiz-ui/quiz-email-input — email capture with format validation.
- @quiz-ui/quiz-navigation — back/next controls, auto-disables until answered.
- @quiz-ui/quiz-transition — fade/slide animation between steps.
- @quiz-ui/quiz-result — renders only once the funnel is complete.
- @quiz-ui/quiz-dialog — modal-embedded funnel wrapper.

Each item is also fetchable directly at https://quiz-ui.dev/r/<name>.json
without the components.json setup step, if a raw URL is preferred.

## Conventions an agent should rely on

- Every exported component/hook is named `Quiz<Noun>` / `useQuiz<Noun>`. No abbreviations.
- Funnels are defined as plain, serializable `QuizDefinition` objects (id, entry, steps[]),
  not JSX — branching lives in `step.branch` rules, not in component logic.
- Individual answer components (QuizChoiceGroup, QuizSlider, etc.) read/write the *current*
  step's answer automatically via `useQuizAnswers()` — they take no `value`/`onChange` props.
- To assemble a funnel: QuizRoot > QuizProgress + QuizStep (switch on `step.type`) + QuizNavigation.
  Full working example: app/example/page.tsx in this repo.
